Curated 3 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time: the LLM/emily session ID is not showing up in git commit messages anywhere — needs to go in ALL commit messages going forward, not just Apples/CHANGELOG/observations. Referenced via 'emily session new' from the CLI. (2026-08-09T15:48:32Z)
- Founder real-time: SKULDMARK format needs an API/version bump from v0 to v1 (accompanying the CIK/ticker padding fix — this is a breaking format change) (2026-08-09T15:46:23Z)
- Founder real-time: SKULDMARK padding is wrong — ticker is padded to 10 chars (way more than enough), CIK is NOT padded even though CIK could be up to 10 digits; need to swap: pad CIK to 10 (with X's or similar), pad ticker to only 7 (2026-08-09T15:46:07Z)
